items.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My friend and the great comic artist, Bill Cosby, does a foreword for the book

ctx.x: A monstrous project. Who is the publisher?
The publisher is Temple University Press. My friend and the great comic artist, Bill Cosby, does a foreword for the book; Wynton does the introduction, Wynton Marsalis. That’s pretty good.

That’s wonderful. Well you made reference to some of your students. Perhaps we should talk about education and your involvement in music education, first. Since the original Smithsonian Oral History on you, which took place in 1995, you have left your position at Queens College. You had an eleven-year tenure, is that correct?
